items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: George and a fellow called Frazier played bass horn. He played back there with Lewis.

ctx.x: But you don't remember hearing many spirituals or gospel music in the church you think when

you were up there? I heard them at camp meetings. I threw in one of the same park as a camp meeting, I always remember, yeah. And it's just like I heard Mahalia Jackson last night. I mean that music's got a swing to it. When that piano starts to kind of vamp and then you know give it an intro, it's a swing there. And I've been hearing that all my life. It's a swing there. Now about those Methodists and the Catholics and the Protestants, a boy named Chigar, I was raised up. His name was, I think his name was…
How was the hat was it, you said he had on a sailor hat or something?
